map.庭院养护季开始前生成整季计划，避免漏掉关键养护节点。: Generate a whole-season plan before the garden maintenance season starts so key nodes are not missed.

map.暖季与冷季草坪的差异: Differences between warm-season and cool-season lawns
map.：暖季型草坪在生长旺季修剪频率更高、施肥周期更短；冷季型草坪在高温期需降低修剪频: : warm-season lawns need more frequent mowing and shorter fertilising intervals in peak growth; cool-season lawns need less mowing in hot periods with adjusted feeding. The page applies different task frequencies by lawn type so the two species do not share one plan.
map.按起始日期排出首月计划: Produce the first month's plan from the start date
map.：设定起始日期后，页面按各任务的周期依次推算出下次养护日期；把实际执行日期回填后: : after setting the start date, the page rolls forward each task's next maintenance date by its cycle; feeding back the actual execution dates makes the plan update continuously from the most recent record.
map.草坪与养护记录保存在浏览器本地存储，不会上传；换设备或清理浏览器数据后需重新录入: Lawn and maintenance records are stored in browser local storage and never uploaded; you must re-enter them after changing devices or clearing browser data.
map.暖季和冷季怎么选？: How do I choose warm-season or cool-season?
map.按所种草种选择：结缕草、狗牙根等属暖季型，早熟禾、黑麦草等属冷季型；不确定时可先: Choose by the species being planted: zoysia and bermudagrass are warm-season types, while Kentucky bluegrass and ryegrass are cool-season; when unsure, judge by local climate and the species description first.
map.页面按内置任务（修剪、施肥、浇水等）生成周期，暂不支持自定义新任务；可在记录备注: The page generates cycles from built-in tasks (mowing, fertilising, watering etc.) and does not yet support custom tasks; add personalised arrangements in the notes.
